confidence_notes: Food and drink anchors are rough estimates from thin, partly dated sources: a 2016 review for draft beer, two Santa Fe cafe menus for cappuccino, undated generic cost-of-living sites for meals, and no reliable Santa Fe price data for cocktails or wine (beer and cocktail are set from general US-market knowledge, and the wine glass is a judgment from one venue's entry price). Restaurant anchors are the most grounded of the set but still uncertain. Accommodation anchors are holistic model estimates for a July peak-season window; no booking pages or current listings were inspected, and their uncertainty is high.
comparable_city_reasoning: No formal comparable city was used. Basis is general US mid-sized tourist-destination pricing, adjusted upward for Santa Fe, since sources say dining and groceries run above the US average (transport and altitude). Cappuccino is anchored to a Santa Fe cafe menu ($3.50 to $4.50). Cocktail and wine are set relative to the beer anchor, because direct Santa Fe bar prices were not found. Accommodation reflects the city's strong seasonal demand and limited budget lodging.
